steps.en: Install the matching core binary and initialize its workspace
steps.zh: 安装匹配的核心程序并初始化工作区

steps.en: Configure a model, Telegram credentials and an explicit sender allowlist
steps.zh: 配置模型、Telegram 凭据和明确的发送者白名单

steps.en: Set tool policy, start the gateway and message your bot
steps.zh: 设置工具策略，启动网关并给机器人发任务

steps.en: Receives the message and calls your model with session context
steps.zh: 接收消息，带着会话上下文调用你的模型

steps.en: Runs permitted tools, feeds results back and replies in the same chat
steps.zh: 执行获准工具，回传结果并在原聊天回复

value.en: Your small board answers and acts through chat without a Python or Node.js core runtime
value.zh: 小板子通过聊天接任务并回复，核心不需另装解释器
